notes.subject: נקבה תסובב גבר
notes.rationale: Tanim tok i tambu tru: 'meri i raunim man' — narapela ol i tok 'meri i lukautim man' (BSB), 'meri i bagarapim man', o i binainim long man; wanpela tok i gat planti min

notes.subject: תתחמקין
notes.rationale: 'yu save tambu na i no kam bek' — KJV 'go about', JPS 'turn away coyly'; em i pasin bilong lukluk narapela rot

notes.subject: שובבה
notes.rationale: Hap bilong שוב (kam bek) — i wankain olsem 'i no save kam bek'; sanap wantaim 'שובי' long v21, i lus long Tok Pisin

translation: Gohap long taim bilong wanem yu save tambu na i no kam bek, pikinini meri i no harim tok? Long wanem Yahwe i mekim kamap wanpela samting nupela long graun: meri i raunim man.

tokens.gloss: yu save tambu na i no kam bek
